Module com.example.miniproyecto3
Package com.example.miniproyecto3.util

Class DialogUtil

java.lang.Object
com.example.miniproyecto3.util.DialogUtil
public class DialogUtil extends Object
Provides simple, custom-styled modal dialogs used throughout the application, since the project favors a fully custom look over the default JavaFX Alert styling. This class cannot be instantiated; all functionality is exposed through static methods.
Version:
1.0
Author:
Maria Alejandra Pizarro Sarria, Alejandro Valencia Sandoval

  • Method Details

    • showError

      public static void showError(String message)
      Displays a modal, undecorated error dialog with the given message and a single dismiss button. Blocks the calling thread until the dialog is closed.
      Parameters:
      message - the error message to display.

    • showAceDialog

      public static int showAceDialog()
      Displays a modal, undecorated dialog asking the player to choose the value of an Ace they are about to play (1 or 10). Blocks the calling thread until the player makes a choice.
      Returns:
      1 or 10, depending on which option the player chose.
